summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and existing test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) using the shared venv's python. mypy and black were not run because the venv only has pytest; type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed. Choices: non-node check uses isinstance(..., Node) since BNode was not an allowed import; the rdf:nil branch is covered only via the "()" test case; None and plain-string inputs are tested in a separate test.
